describe: Reviewed exceptional-state handling for this vendor product. A single discovery run cannot be relied on to encounter a session timeout, a transient host failure and a maintenance notice, so these are authored and reviewed once per product rather than rediscovered per capability. Detectors match in any frame unless a framePath is given.
